column4: Morning David, let's keep this short. The main item today is the Harbor Logistics renewal.
Right. Their contract ends on the thirtieth of November, and they have asked for a two year term instead of one.
That works if they accept the new pricing. What did their finance team say about the four percent increase?
They pushed back a little, but I think three and a half percent with a two year term is acceptable to them.
Okay. Let's offer three and a half percent, two years, and keep the current service levels.
Agreed. I will draft the renewal proposal and send it to Maria for review by Thursday.
Good. Action items then. David drafts the proposal by Thursday. I will check the usage report for October.
And someone needs to book the review call with their operations lead next week.
I will do that too. Anything else?
One last reminder. The renewal pack should include the updated service level summary, so please attach it.
Will do. I will attach it before Maria reviews the draft.
No, that covers it. Thanks Sarah.
